text:
Air in a sealed syringe is slowly compressed by moving the piston. The temperature of the air
stays the same.
air
syringe
piston
Which statement about the air is correct?
A
The pressure of the air decreases because its particles now travel more slowly.
B
The pressure of the air decreases because the area of the syringe walls is now smaller.
C
The pressure of the air increases because its particles now hit the syringe walls more
frequently.
D
The pressure of the air increases because its particles now travel more quickly.

options.label: A
options.text: The pressure of the air decreases because its particles now travel more slowly.

options.label: B
options.text: The pressure of the air decreases because the area of the syringe walls is now smaller.

options.label: C
options.text: The pressure of the air increases because its particles now hit the syringe walls more

options.label: D
options.text: The pressure of the air increases because its particles now travel more quickly.
